name: guard
description: When a turn ends, guard asks the session to run its router subagent over the response; the router names which audit agents would actually find something in it — unsupported claims, deferrals the repo could answer, explanation the reader cannot follow, unnatural Korean, comments in the source it edited — each with a reason, and they run in parallel. One switch per agent, all off until you turn one on. Claude Code and Codex. Requires Python 3.11+.

interface.shortDescription: Audit finished turns for unsupported claims
